| description = Starting Nov 2000 in the EQ patch timeline (patched Oct 2024 on p99), Trissa Whistlesong increases to level 35 and becomes very difficult to kill for her level. She was previously a Level 15 undercon who was heavily camped because of being easy for her level and being good cash for her level with the mandolin drop. Originally she also pathed in a way that made it easy to kite her around the room, as she would run the long way around the carpet each time, while you could jump back and forth between the tables.

Respawns every 6 minutes and 40 seconds. You'll receive negative faction hits with bards and [[Knights of Truth]], the faction for paladin guards in [[North Freeport]] nearby. You can still sell to the merchant right next to her spawn if you have sufficient [[Coalition of Tradefolk]] faction.

See also: [[6-Minute Bard Diet]]
